subject: POC Observability Plan and Success Criteria - FintechX
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC Observability Plan and Success Criteria - FintechX

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture next steps and a proposed observability plan for the POC so your team can validate performance, latency, and correctness during trial. Below is a concise plan we can iterate on: 

POC goals / success criteria:
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 350ms under representative load (see suggested load below)
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% for inference requests
- Cost visibility: per-token cost and token breakdown by route/model for the POC period
- Functional: generation quality meets your evaluation suite (we’ll run your 100-case prompt set)

Observability deliverables (what we’ll provide/configure):
- Dashboards: pre-built Grafana-style dashboards for token-level cost, latency distribution (p50/p95/p99), request volume, and error rates
- Tracing: distributed traces for requests, showing model selection, queuing time, and kernel execution time (OpenTelemetry-compatible)
- Logs: structured request/response logs with request_id, model_version, route, user_id (redacted per privacy) — log export to your S3 bucket or our secure transfer
- Metrics export: Prometheus metrics endpoint and optional push to your monitoring (we can push to Datadog)
- Alerts: we’ll provision alert rules for latency SLO breaches, error spikes, and model fallback occurrences

Evaluation plan & timelines:
- Kickoff & environment access: Week 0 (as soon as NDA/contract milestones complete)
- Setup & baseline run (integrations, sample traffic): Week 1
- Controlled load + evaluation runs (your 100-case prompt set + synthetic load): Week 2
- Analyze results + tuning (batching, cache, quant profiles): Week 3
- Decision & recap: Week 4

Ownership & contacts:
- Redwood POC lead: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai) — overall coordination, dashboards, alerts
- Redwood infra/obs engineer: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.ai) — tracing, metrics, integrations
- FintechX POC lead: Alex Johnson (alex.johnson@fintechx.com) — evaluation owner
- FintechX data eng: Priya Menon (priya.menon@fintechx.com) — S3/monitoring access

Actions for Alex / FintechX before kickoff:
1) Confirm the evaluation prompt set and share as a spreadsheet (we saw you have ~100 cases)
2) Provide S3 write credentials or a Datadog/Prometheus endpoint for metrics export
3) Identify any logging/PII constraints we should enforce (fields to redact)

I attached a short success-criteria workbook to make sign-off easier. Happy to hop on a 30m kickoff next week — when’s good for your team?

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0119

Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan and Success Criteria - FintechX

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications and requests from our side: 

- Confirmed success criteria: latency and reliability targets look good. We also want to track token-level hallucination rate for the 100-case prompt set (whether the model returns unsupported financial advice). Can you add a simple QA metric for that?
- Metrics/exports: Priya can provide an S3 bucket with write credentials; she’ll send creds to Marcus. We also use Datadog for ops and would prefer metrics pushed there if straightforward.
- Stakeholders: I’ll own evaluation outcomes; Priya will handle access. Legal is still reviewing the contract but expects to finish by EOD Wed.

We attached the evaluation prompt set (Excel) in this reply — please confirm receipt. Can we target kickoff next Thursday (June 10) at 11:00 PT? If Legal finishes early we can start earlier.

Quick note on data: we need request/response logs redacted for account numbers and full SSNs — we can share the full list of fields to redact.

Appreciate the quick turn.

—Alex
Head of AI Integrations
FintechX
alex.johnson@fintechx.com

Thanks — I’ll take point on the traces and metrics export. Priya, can you share the S3 write ARN and Datadog API key scope (we only need metrics ingest) to marcus_lin@redwood.ai? I’ll provision an OpenTelemetry collector and set up dashboard links (Grafana) and a Datadog integration.

Technical notes / checklist for the POC:
- Cross-account IAM role with PutObject to the provided S3 prefix (logs/)
- Datadog API key with metrics ingest only (no full event export)
- Redaction: list of fields to redact before logs land in S3 (we’ll apply regex-based scrubbing)
- Tracing: ensure X-Request-ID passed from FintechX client to Redwood for trace correlation

I’ll post the dashboard links once they’re live and share an initial baseline report after the first run.
